pages.title: Vithalbhai Patel — 100 years as first Indian President of Central Legislative Assembly

facts.text: Event: All India Speakers' Conference (Delhi Legislative Assembly, August 2025) — centenary of his election
facts.head: News

facts.text: India Post: commemorative stamp in 2025; Lok Sabha centenary souvenir 1973
facts.head: News

facts.text: Year: 27 Sept 1873; Event: born Nadiad, Gujarat — elder brother of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel
facts.head: Life

facts.text: Year: 1923; Event: co-founded Swaraj Party with Motilal Nehru, C.R. Das (opposed suspension of NCM after Chauri Chaura, 1922)
facts.head: Life

facts.text: Year: 22 August 1925; Event: first Indian President of Central Legislative Assembly (Speaker-equivalent)
facts.head: Life

facts.text: Year: 1928; Event: Motilal Nehru motion (backed by Lala Lajpat Rai) for separate Assembly Department
facts.head: Life

facts.text: Year: 1929; Event: independent Legislative Assembly Secretariat created
facts.head: Life

facts.text: Year: 22 Oct 1933; Event: died in Geneva
facts.head: Life

facts.text: Refused to stand to receive the Viceroy — dignity of the chair
facts.head: Contributions

facts.text: After Bhagat Singh–Batukeshwar Dutt bomb (1929), kept "ward and watch" security under the President — continued till 2024 when CISF took over
facts.head: Contributions

facts.text: Later allied with Subhas Chandra Bose; will left estate for Bose's work — family won court case
facts.head: Contributions
